To generate the integrated object of Rayon's MN + Juyoung's iPSC-MNs.



# import Data
```{r}
library(dplyr)

library(Seurat)
library(magrittr)
# install.packages("anndata")
library(anndata)
```
```{r}
library(reticulate)
reticulate::use_condaenv(condaenv = "scanpy_in_r")  # conda env with scanpy + scvi-tools
reticulate::py_config()
sc <- import("scanpy", convert = FALSE)
scvi <- import("scvi", convert = FALSE)
# scib <- import("scib_metrics.benchmark", convert = FALSE)

# library(rJava)
```

```{r}
# juyoung's IPSC
if(!exists("iPSC")){            # 26945 86943 
  iPSC <- readRDS("../results/iPSC_filtered_merged_soupX_scanvilabeled_seurat_obj_juyoung.RDS")
  DefaultAssay(iPSC) <- "RNA" 
}

# Rayon's
if(!exists("embryonic_sc_rayon")){ # 33538 x 43485 
  embryonic_sc_rayon <- readRDS("../data/reference/GSE171892_merged_postqc_SCT_seurat_obj.RDS") # embryonic period 3 - 8 weeks
  DefaultAssay(embryonic_sc_rayon) <- "RNA"
}
```

```{r}
embryonic_sc_rayon@meta.data <- embryonic_sc_rayon@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    subtype_annotation = type_step2,
    top_level_annotation = type_step1
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    new_consolidated_annotation = case_when(
      grepl("FP", subtype_annotation) ~ "Floor plate cells (FP)",
      grepl("MFOL|MOL|NFOL|Oligo", subtype_annotation) ~ "Oligodendrocytes (Oligo)",
      grepl("RP", subtype_annotation) ~ "Roof plate (RP)",
      grepl("^MN", subtype_annotation) ~ "Motor neurons (MN)",
      grepl("^pMN", subtype_annotation) ~ "Motor neuron progenitors (MNP)",
      grepl("Neural_crest_progenitor", subtype_annotation) ~ "Neural crest progenitors cells (NCP)",
      grepl("Null_Neuron", subtype_annotation) ~ "Pan neurons (Pan-N)",
      grepl("Null_Progenitor", subtype_annotation) ~ "Neural progenitor cells (NPC)",
      grepl("Sensory_neuron_progenitor", subtype_annotation) ~ "Dorsal progenitors (DP)",
      grepl("Unspecialised_sensory_neuron", subtype_annotation) ~ "Sensory neurons (SN)",
      # added on 2024.11.01
      grepl("LTMR", subtype_annotation) ~ "Peripheral neuron (PN)",
      grepl("dl", subtype_annotation) ~ "Dorsal interneuron (DI)",
      grepl("dp", subtype_annotation) ~ "Dorsal progenitor (DP)",
      grepl("^p[0-9]", subtype_annotation) ~ "Ventral progenitor (VP)",
      TRUE ~ subtype_annotation  # fallback to the original annotation if no match is found
    ),
    # new_consolidated_annotation_abbr = gsub(".*\\((.*)\\).*", "\\1", new_consolidated_annotation)
  )
```

## subset of (v)MNs
```{r}
# subset of MNs
iPSC_MN <- subset(iPSC, subset = new_consolidated_annotation %in% c("Motor neurons (MN)", "Visceral motor neurons (v-MN)"))
embryonic_sc_rayon_MN <- subset(embryonic_sc_rayon, subset = new_consolidated_annotation %in% c("Motor neurons (MN)"))
```

```{r}
# find common features between objects
rnames <- sapply(list(iPSC_MN, embryonic_sc_rayon_MN), rownames) 
names(rnames) <- c("iPSC_MN", "embryonic_sc_rayon_MN")
lapply(rnames, head, n=30)
sapply(rnames, length)
common <- purrr::reduce(rnames, intersect)
length(common) # 31,915 names in common in RNA assay 
```

## merge
```{r}
iPSC_MN$sample <- "iPSC"                # 2991
embryonic_sc_rayon_MN$sample <- "Rayon" # 2326

# merge the objects 
merged_meta_MN <- iPSC_MN@meta.data %>% 
  bind_rows(., select(embryonic_sc_rayon_MN@meta.data, everything()))

iPSC_MN <- JoinLayers(iPSC_MN)
embryonic_sc_rayon_MN <- JoinLayers(embryonic_sc_rayon_MN)
merged_MN_modifiedbarcode <-  CreateSeuratObject(counts = list("ipsc"=LayerData(iPSC_MN, layer = 'counts')[common,],
                                                                "embryonic_sc_rayon"=LayerData(embryonic_sc_rayon_MN, layer = 'counts')[common,]), 
                                                 meta.data = merged_meta_MN)

# Note: scvi-tools requires raw gene expression
DefaultAssay(merged_MN_modifiedbarcode) <- "RNA"
merged_MN_scanvi_obj <- DietSeurat(merged_MN_modifiedbarcode, assays = "RNA")

# re-join layers since convertFormat expects a Seurat v3 object https://github.com/satijalab/seurat/issues/8214 
merged_MN_scanvi_obj <- JoinLayers(merged_MN_scanvi_obj)
merged_MN_scanvi_obj <- NormalizeData(merged_MN_scanvi_obj)

# transpose the raw counts (dense) matrix
# note: MT genes have already been removed from the counts matrix
tr_counts_mat <- t(as.matrix(LayerData(merged_MN_scanvi_obj, layer = "counts")))
tr_norm_mat <- t(as.matrix(LayerData(merged_MN_scanvi_obj, layer = "data")))

# convert to anndata object
adata <- anndata::AnnData(
  X = tr_norm_mat,
  obs = as.data.frame(merged_MN_scanvi_obj@meta.data),
  var = as.data.frame(GetAssay(merged_MN_scanvi_obj)[[]]),
  layers = list(counts = tr_counts_mat,
                lognorm = tr_norm_mat))

dir.create("../results/integrated_MN", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
anndata::write_h5ad(adata, filename = file.path("../results/integrated_MN/iPSC_rayon_vMN_MN_merged.h5ad"))

# if reticulate doesn't work
# Save matrices and metadata as CSV
# write.csv(tr_norm_mat, "tr_norm_mat.csv", row.names = TRUE)
# write.csv(tr_counts_mat, "tr_counts_mat.csv", row.names = TRUE)
# write.csv(as.data.frame(merged_MN_scanvi_obj@meta.data), "metadata.csv", row.names = TRUE)
# write.csv(as.data.frame(GetAssay(merged_MN_scanvi_obj)[[]]), "features.csv", row.names = TRUE)
# tr_counts_mat <- read_csv("tr_counts_mat.csv")
```

## integrated
The integrated was processed via SCANVI. Please refer to 06_scANVI_MN_integration.py

```{r}
table(scanvi_query_adata$obs$new_consolidated_annotation)
```
